subject: Clarify commission triggers, implementation fee, and lead registration for Lumina integration
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@lumina.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Theo Martins <theo@lumina.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Potential integration + commercial model question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile and the rollout controls. We have two quick commercial questions as we prepare to take this to procurement:

1) Do you support a referral-only path (we'd send leads) as well as reseller (we would resell Redwood-backed instances) under the same contract?
2) If a referral, how do you typically handle attribution windows and revenue-share start triggers (e.g., invoice paid vs. first usage)?

Also our implementation folks want to confirm whether Redwood charges a one-time integration/validation fee for ISV storefronts or if that is rolled into channel pricing.

Attached are our standard partner intake docs for reference (we can send procurement later). Happy to jump on a call if easier.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Partnerships — Lumina Analytics
-- Attachment: Lumina-Partner-Intake.pdf (pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@lumina.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Potential integration + commercial model question

Hi Jordan — great to hear from you, and glad the demo landed well. Short answers up top, details below:

- Yes, we support both referral and reseller models (separate commercial exhibits).
- Attribution window: standard is 90 days for lead registration; revenue-share typically triggers on first invoice paid, but we can discuss usage-based triggers for ARR deals.
- Implementation fee: we generally include a one-time onboarding fee when there is a dedicated implementation workstream (e.g., custom connectors, onboarding validation). For lightweight integrations we waive it and absorb it into a promotional credit.

I'll loop Ben (field/sales) and Marissa (partner ops) to propose specific percentages and a short MAT (mutual action timeline) based on Lumina's expected go-to-market.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
-- Attachment: Redwood-Partner-Program-OnePager.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@lumina.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Potential integration + commercial model question

Jordan — quick commercial proposal from our side so you have something tangible for procurement:

Option A (Referral):
- 15% revenue share on net revenue attributable to Lumina-registered leads.
- 90-day lead registration window from first touch (same as our standard).
- Trigger: revenue-share begins on first paid invoice for the customer.
- Payout cadence: quarterly net of refunds/credits.

Option B (Reseller):
- Lumina resells Redwood-managed instances at a discount of 22% from list; Lumina invoices customer directly; Redwood invoices Lumina for hosting/consumption monthly.
- Implementation fee: $12,500 one-time for reseller onboarding (covers validation, SSO, and billing integration).

We can be flexible on the referral % for strategic co-markets and can add an acceleration to 20% for the first 12 months for named accounts.

Notes on registration: registrations must include baseline info (company name, contact, expected ARR) and are submitted via our Partner Portal (or spreadsheet for fast pilots). We keep a rolling log and notify partners within 5 business days of acceptance.

If this looks reasonable, Marissa will send a short commercial exhibit and a draft MSA for review.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
-- Attachment: Redwood-Commission-Schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@lumina.com>, Theo Martins <theo@lumina.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Potential integration + commercial model question

Jordan / Theo — dropping the commercial exhibit and MSA draft for review. Key clarifications included in the attached:

- Lead registration form fields and minimum qualification criteria (MQL) so we have consistent acceptance.
- 90-day attribution window with an exception process for accounts with procurement timelines longer than 120 days (requires written escalation).
- Revenue-share: referral payments quarterly; breakdown and reporting template included.
- Implementation fees for reseller: listed as a line in Exhibit B with scope items and acceptance criteria.

If procurement wants different invoicing terms (Net45 / Net60), call that out in redlines — fiscal needs are usually the sticking point. We also attached a sample PO template to speed procurement.

Next steps: please provide proposed redlines by Oct 7 and we can route to legal. If procurement prefers, we can spin a DocuSign envelope for signature after redlines.

Marissa
Partner Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
-- Attachment: Partner-MSA-v2.docx (docx)
-- Attachment: Redwood-Lumina-Commercial-Summary.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Procurement <procurement@lumina.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Potential integration + commercial model question

Hi Marissa — thanks for the materials. A few procurement items and redlines from our side:

1) Payment terms: Lumina requests Net60 for the first 12 months of the pilot; can Redwood accept Net45?
2) PO/Invoice matching: we need an appendix template for tax and billing contact fields for our AP system.
3) SOW acceptance: can the onboarding acceptance criteria include a 10-business-day remediation window for any critical integration failures?

We have a draft PO and suggested MSA redlines attached. If Redwood is fine with Net45 and the 10-business-day remediation clause, we can sign a DocuSign envelope this week. Please confirm and provide a DocuSign link.

Regards,
Lumina Procurement Team
-- Attachment: Lumina-PO-Draft.pdf (pdf)
-- Attachment: Lumina-MSA-Redlines.docx (docx)
